title: Choose Agent Factory's visual world
question: Keep the production-traveler direction, choose a dealt alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Production Traveler
options.lineage: industrial job travelers, routing dockets, and inspection stamps
options.thesis: Every software change becomes a tangible job moving through named specialist stations and human approval gates.
options.viewport: A monumental routing docket fills the first screen: Agent Factory names the job, a live flow line crosses specialist stations, and Install is the first stamped action.
options.risk: The factory metaphor becomes costume if stamps and docket details do not carry real workflow meaning.

options.label: The Tension Network
options.lineage: tensegrity structures of carbon rods and tensioned cord
options.thesis: Specialist agents hold one delivery system in balance through visible constraints and counterchecks.
options.case: Strong mechanism fit, but the structural metaphor is less immediately familiar to software teams than a routed job.
options.viewport: A large interactive constraint graph assembles across the hero while the install action anchors its base.
options.risk: The spatial system can obscure the simple sequential path a new visitor needs first.

options.label: The Safelight Process
options.lineage: printing darkrooms with timed baths and contact sheets
options.thesis: A change emerges through deliberate stages, with previews and checks before commitment.
options.case: The staged process is clear, though developers identify less directly with photographic craft.
options.viewport: The workflow develops from ghosted gray to sharp black across a wide contact sheet, ending at a crisp install control.
options.risk: Amber atmosphere may overpower documentation legibility and make a fast tool feel slow.

options.label: The Drawcord System
options.lineage: transforming garments with routed channels and tensioned cords
options.thesis: One deliberate pull coordinates many hidden channels into a protective delivery shape.
options.case: Beautiful orchestration metaphor, but it explains specialist verification less clearly than the assigned route.
options.viewport: A black semicircle spans the page as one gold route gathers it through workflow stages toward installation.
options.risk: Fashion materiality may feel detached from the evidence-led engineering audience.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A familiar product hero, feature summary, workflow section, and installation guide executed at a high craft level.
canonCard.viewport: A conventional headline and code sample introduce the product above a familiar feature grid.
canonCard.risk: Immediate comprehension comes at the cost of a distinctive Agent Factory identity.
